title: Poland's president accuses Tusk government of taking over top court
caption:
Poland's Constitutional Tribunal is in chaos after a judge suspended its president, an appointee of the former Law and Justice government. President Karol Nawrocki flew back from a trip to Senegal and called it a forced takeover, while Prime Minister Donald Tusk says he is restoring the rule of law. Nawrocki has called urgent talks with party leaders.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
